welcome.title: These memories are just for our family.
welcome.text: Thank you for stopping by. Every photo here is private and shared only with family members, so there's nothing to see for visitors. If you're part of the family, sign in or request access and a family admin will let you in.
welcome.small: New accounts are reviewed by a family admin before any photo is shown.
